todo: Purpose: Mark genuine vessel mooring points without filling every quay tile with generic clutter.
Visual brief: Heavy round iron bollard with flared base and a bright worn rope groove; the object stays round despite cell placement.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 1x1 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Scale: no density3 bollard class exists; start below barrel height (31-46 art px) and review against a 74-art-px adult rather than inventing a new class.
Rule proposal: a tied boat and bollard share one mooring relation; ropes do not cross a public route.
